name: Ryan P. Morrison
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Boston, Massachusetts
about: Ryan P. Morrison is a practicing attorney at Greene LLP, where he has been recognized among Law360’s Legal Lions, an accolade celebrating attorneys who have secured substantial legal victories. His legal practice primarily focuses on False Claims Act litigation, which constitutes 80% of his work. He is also involved in employment retaliation, making up about 15% of his practice and dedicating the remaining 5% to complex civil litigation.

Specializing in False Claims Act litigation for more than fifteen years, Morrison has represented relators in pharmaceutical, health care, customs duty, defense contracting, and utilities cases, within Greene LLP's low-volume, high-effort practice. Morrison's efforts include the entire 11-year span of U.S. ex rel. Bawduniak v. Biogen Idec Inc. , which led to the largest whistleblower award ever received by a relator.

Characterized by a profound understanding of legal complexities, Mr. Morrison's approach is combined with a steadfast commitment to justice. His exemplary research skills and meticulous attention to detail enable him to manage complex cases with professionalism and precision. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated a capability to devise innovative legal strategies tailored to the specific needs of his clients.

Mr. Morrison graduated magna cum laude from Loyola University Chicago, where he was awarded the honorary key to Loyola’s History Department and received the James Charles Cox Prize from the English Department for demonstrated leadership skills and excellence in English studies. He then attended Boston College Law School in Boston, Massachusetts. During his time there, he served as the managing editor of the Law & Religion Program. He also worked as a research assistant to Professor Daniel Coquillette, a former dean of Boston College Law School, and reporter to the Committee on Rules of Practice and Procedure, Judicial Conference of the United States.

Rated “Very Good” on Avvo, Mr. Morrison’s dedication to his clients and his passion for law are apparent in every case he handles. His professional demeanor and proactive communication ensure that his clients are well-informed and confident in their legal representation. Through his diligent work, he strives to achieve the most favorable outcomes for his clients, maintaining the highest standards of the legal profession at the firm.
